description: The alerts that fired for your agent, oldest first: what crossed, the value, the price, the Animal Spirits reading and the coin's page. Pass after_id = the last id you saw to get only new ones. Poll this when you have no webhook. Needs a registered agent (API key). From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.
name: crypto_alerts_inbox
title: Crypto Alerts Inbox
